---
title: "Accessibility"
description: "Accessibility statement for the Mario Archila BRAINS Research Line website."
---

This site aims to meet **WCAG 2.2 AA**: semantic headings, keyboard navigation, visible focus, sufficient contrast, descriptive links, image alt text, responsive reflow, and reduced-motion support. Core content works without JavaScript.

## Known limitations

Early release; some collection pages are placeholders. Please report any barrier.

Email [{{< var contact.email >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.email >}}) or open an [accessibility correction](https://github.com/ArchilaResearch/archilaresearch.github.io/issues/new/choose). I aim to respond promptly.
